title: Retrospective analysis of the comparison between carbon dioxide laser-assisted deep sclerectomy combined with phacoemulsification and conventional trabeculectomy with phacoemulsification

license.statement: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution-Noncommercial-Share Alike); non-commercial and share-alike, therefore private

indication: medically uncontrolled open-angle glaucoma (primary open-angle glaucoma in 15 patients, pseudoexfoliation glaucoma in 3) with cataract, adults without previous ocular surgery; each patient had phaco-trabeculectomy in one eye and phaco combined with CO2 laser-assisted deep sclerectomy (LADS) in the other; no antimetabolite mentioned; retrospective, follow-up of at least 1 year required

groups.description: Phacoemulsification with conventional trabeculectomy, one eye per patient (Table 2 column 'PHACO + TRAB (n=18)')
Phacoemulsification with CO2 laser-assisted deep sclerectomy, fellow eye of the same patients (Table 2 column 'PHACO + LADS (n=18)')

series.notes: mean ± SD (the Results text labels these values mean ± SD; asterisks ignored); blocks 'Baseline', '6 months', '1 year', '2 years', '3 years', '4 years'; per-visit number of patients in Table 2 rows R6, R11, R16, R21, R26, R31 (column C2); strong attrition in year 4 (Results)
mean ± SD; same blocks as the trabeculectomy series; per-visit number of patients in Table 2 rows R6, R11, R16, R21, R26, R31 (column C3)

exclusions.reason: medication counts are mentioned in notes only; BCVA is not IOP
Kaplan-Meier success estimates are not admissible

exclusions.what: Day 1 and months 1, 3 and 9 visits listed in the Methods/Abstract

notes: Tonometer: not stated in the article.
Reference: baseline IOP with the baseline number of anti-glaucoma medications (Table 2 row R4), recorded as preoperative_medicated.
Statistic: the statistical methods mention mean (SD) or median (IQR) for continuous variables; the Results text reports the Table 2 IOP values explicitly as mean ± SD, so they are taken as means.
Role: two clinical techniques compared retrospectively without an arm declared experimental; both groups are recorded as control with their own procedure context (trabeculectomy, nonpenetrating).
Paired design: the two groups are the two eyes of the same 18 patients.
Goniopuncture and bleb needling were used as routine postoperative interventions and not counted as failure (Methods); no outcome-defined exclusion from the means is stated.
Table 2 tabulates the number of anti-glaucoma medications at each visit; not extracted.
